> OddsPapi is a REST and WebSocket API that aggregates real-time and historical
> odds from 350+ bookmakers — including sharps (Pinnacle, Singbet, SBOBet),
> major softs (Bet365, DraftKings, FanDuel), crypto books (1xBet), and exchanges
> (Betfair). Free tier available with no credit card required.
